messages:
Tom H: Hi all  I got an invite for "New Hire Orientation" showing 09:00 on my calendar but no Zoom link and no timezone clarification. Event creator is in PT so my calendar converted it to my local timezone (CEST) but the invite text is ambiguous. Can someone post the meeting link + where recording will be saved?

Marta (People Ops): Welcome Tom! :wave: Core orientation is 09:00 PT (16:00 UTC). Zoom link should be in the event, but sometimes the mailer copy strips it out. We store recordings in Drive under /company/onboarding/recordings and a short agenda doc with timestamps will be added after the session.

Onboarding Bot: Auto-note: Orientation events are authored in Pacific Time. Recording + autogenerated transcript will be uploaded to Drive within 24 hours. If you need captions or an accessible transcript, reply here and well prioritize.

Tom H: Thanks. For visibility across timezones, could we add an explicit table in the event description (PT / UTC / local examples)? Im onboarding from Berlin so having an explicit CEST entry would help.

Keiko S: Totally agree  as a recent hire from Tokyo I missed an event because my client showed UTC only. For this session: Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/4567890123 (passcode: rw2026). We also attach an .ics in the event description and include PT + UTC times in the body now.

Calendar Team: Quick FYI from Calendar Ops: organizers create events in the "Redwood Onboarding" calendar which defaults to PT. If you see duplicates, open the one from that calendar (not the email invite) to reveal the link. Well update the template to include a simple timezone table and a Drive link placeholder so the recording location is visible before the call.

Tom H: Appreciate the link. One more: will the recording have chapter markers or a timestamped agenda? Skipping ahead helps when catching up across jobs.

Marta (People Ops): Yes, well add a timestamped agenda doc to the Drive folder and request chapter markers/captions from the recording team. If thats not possible for this run, well at least add timestamps in the Drive doc and highlight key segments.

Keiko S: Also ping Calendar Ops if you need the .ics resent. Some clients (Outlook mobile, Apple Calendar) hide details on merged invites.

Onboarding Bot: Reminder set: "Upload orientation recording & transcript to Drive" scheduled for +24h after event; post will include agenda with timestamps.

Tom H: Great, thanks everyone. Ill accept the invite and watch the recording if timezones make live attendance tricky.
